newsitem.title: USA: American Real Estate sets record date.
newsitem.headline: American Real Estate sets record date.

text.p: American Real Estate Partners LP said Friday the record date for its proposed rights offering will be August 8.
The proposed subscription period will be 30 calendar days beginning on the date subscription materials are mailed to record date holders.

According to the terms of the offering, holders of record of the company's depositary units representing limited partnership interests will receive one transferable right for each five depositary units held, subject to rounding.
Each right will entitle the holder to buy from the company four depositary units and one 5 percent cumulative pay-in-kind redeemable preferred unit.

Exercising rights holders will be entitled to an over-subscription privilege for all or any portion of the depositary units and preferred units not purchased through the exercise of primary subscription rights.

The depositary units and the preferred units purchased through the exercise of primary subscription rights must be purchased as a unit consisting of four depositary units and one preferred unit and may not be subscribed for separately.
